The '''street hustler''' is a resident of [[Freeside]] who appears briefly {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
This man approaches [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[the Ghoul]] while they walk through Freeside. He is wearing a double-sided sign that reads "BEAT ME UP 4 [[Bottle cap|CAPS]]," written in red paint. As such, he appears to be offering other Freeside drifters the opportunity to inflict physical pain on him, so long as he receives caps as payment. Lucy politely declines his offer and maneuvers around the man.<ref>{{FOTV|2|5}}</ref>

==Appearances==
The street hustler appears only in the ''Fallout'' TV series.

==Behind the scenes==
This character is portrayed by [[Jay Dersahagian]], an uncredited extra. The character is never given a name in the series, nor is he identified as anything other than "a man" in the episode's audio description; the article title is taken from Dersahagian's description of the role on his resume.<ref>[https://archive.ph/Shzs4 Jay Dersahagian's resume (archived)]</ref>
